entries.en: No. Sounds shady.
Recipient
See it my way.
Tell me or I won't help.
As he should.
I want to buy something.
Sulking?
[LIE] I haven't picked it up.
I gave it to Inamorda.
I gave it to Anoleis.
I'm here to shop. We can discuss this later.
This one does not find that a comfort.
Is there anything else this one might help you with?
Is there anything in particular the Spectre is looking for?
The customer is the krogan called Inamorda. That one is a bounty hunter of some repute, and quick to anger.
Now, does the other have the package?
Are you gracious enough to perform the task for this one?
This one must be discreet. Rest assured, the contents pose no threat to anyone within this port.
I'll get to it, I swear. Just slipped my mind is all.
For what it's worth, I'm sorry. Dealing with Anoleis expedited my mission.
I won't carry anything if I don't know what it is.
Tell me about the job again.
I needed Anoleis' help.
Contents
What are you selling?
[LIE] Not yet.
This one has heard that Inamorda has met an unfortunate end.
This one wants no trouble.
Inamorda was a good customer, but there are always more krogan seeking weapons.
Very well. This one will need the credits.
I'm here as a customer.
Could I buy something?
Find a legal way to make a living.
If that's the best you can do, fine.
Crime doesn't pay.
It will have to do.
Fine, I'll go.
250, huh? The hanar government is communistic, right?
All right. I wouldn't want to get you into trouble.
Only cowards remain anonymous. I don't have to worry about a coward.
Who's the recipient?
It is.
Cheap bastard.
A coward, then.
Huh. Everyone who came back from Peak 15 is being reassigned offworld.
Binary Helix's stock is taking a nosedive. Some big project went belly-up.
I can't believe the administrator is dead. There aren't supposed to be any guns on Noveria.
Synthetic Insights is open again. I wonder what the closure was about?
Look, since the administrator was arrested, our managers are interrogating everyone who talked to you.
You're the Spectre, right? Um, management told us not to talk to you.
They say there hasn't been an accident on Peak 15, but everyone knows.
Something weird is going on at the Synthetic Insights office. The administrator shut 'em down.
Peak 15 has a bio- and cyber-hazards lab. If there's a problem, they should nuke it before it spreads.
I'd ask you out for coffee, but I have to work late tonight. And I might get fired for talking to you. And the coffee here sucks.
I'd love to have your job. Traveling the galaxy, saving lives - that's what I wanted to do as a kid. How'd that turn into accounting?
The blizzard over Peak 15 broke. I told people there was nothing to worry about.
There was no problem at Peak 15. This sort of thing is just to distract simple people from real projects.
Gunplay in the administrator's office is intolerable! I expect to be kept safe from dangerous people. I'm suffering from post-traumatic stress now!
I knew the rumors about Synthetic Insights closing were bogus. The employees here are a bunch of suspicious gossips.
Anoleis was running this place just fine before that Parasini woman came along.
Hunh. The managers warned us about you.
I can't believe the paranoids that work here. There's no accident on Peak 15.
I don't understand these rumors about Synthetic Insights. If the office is closed, it must be for a good reason.
I don't care what happened on Peak 15. We've all signed non-disclosure agreements.
I can't talk to you. It could cost me my job.
There was no problem at Peak 15. This sort of thing is to distract simple people from real projects.
Gunplay in the administrator's office is intolerable! I expect to be kept safe from dangerous people. Now I'm suffering from post-traumatic stress!
The managers warned us about you, Spectre.
The administrator's dead. They're going to take that out of our pay, aren't they?
I guess with Anoleis dead, I won't be getting that bonus pay.
Nobody gets away with going against the Board. Not even the administrator.
When they let Qui'in back into his office, he squawked about blood stains on the carpet. Bastard.
Someone murdered our people in the Synthetic Insights office. Wonder who could have done that?
Sergeant Stirling was killed. When we get the one responsible, we'll take turns "guarding" them.
Don't make us regret letting you keep those guns.
We've got a secret weapon. Sergeant Stirling's a biotic. And not a real friendly one either.
You better toe the line with the administrator. If you don't, you might end up like Lorik Qui'in.
There are people all over this plaza you can chat with. I'm on duty.
Noveria is private property. Remember, you're here at the Board's sufferance.
Anoleis and Parasini shouldn't have been able to get weapons. Heads are going to roll over this.
It doesn't matter what was going on at SI. We've got too much work in the administrator's office now.
Anoleis shouldn't hire us as a private mercenary force. You won't hear me complaining about his arrest.
I don't understand why those guys were in the Synthetic Insights office.
I heard some of the guys were ransacking Synthetic Insights. Captain Matsuo didn't order that.
My sergeant was killed in the SI office. I don't know how I feel about that. She was brutal.
I heard you killed Inamorda. I'm not shedding any tears, but don't cause any more trouble.
I'm on duty, Spectre. I shouldn't be talking to you.
If Sergeant Stirling catches me with you, she'll-- I don't know, crush my trachea with her brain or something.
Some of the guys do side jobs for the administrator. I'll only do what Captain Matsuo says.
You know what I could go for right now? A doughnut.
I'm keeping an eye on that krogan at the hotel. He's a mercenary, name of Inamorda.
Come on. I could get fired for talking to you.
Quarantine lab locked down.
Fuel lines fixed.
Mira offline.
Landlines repaired.
This door can only be opened by Anoleis' assistant.
Synthetic Insights lockdown. Authorization Kaira Stirling.
Elevator locked down by order of Captain J. Ventralis.
Reactor power restored.
Not enough power for restart.
Electronic locks offline. Please consult station Virtual Intelligence.
Connection ports out of sequence. Unable to dock data module.
Memory Core 1 damaged. Transfer module stack to Core 2 or 3 to reactivate. Press Escape to Exit.
This elevator is only accessible to Binary Helix employees.
Elevator locked down until purge activated.
Emergency exit only.
Purge armed.
Authorization Required.
Maintenance door locked. Authorization required.
Hotlabs not accessible.
Synthetic Insights security disabled.
Repairs incomplete.
Core reactivated
Been a while since I've seen you. What brings you back?
Hey, so, what happened up there?
Ain't they all, ain't they all.
No worries. I'm sworn to secrecy for a few of the things I did. Important thing is that you got your people out, right?
Long-lived, those asari. Seen it all and done it twice. She must be a good thousand years old.
She was. But her life ended on the Peak.
She was born when your race was riding around on livestock, waving big knives and dying of sniffles. Living history, there.
Trying to put one over on the old campaigner, eh? It's been an asari's age since there were any rachni.
If you can't say anything, no big deal. Points for imagination though, eh?
I heard the administrator's been arrested. Any chance you had something to do with that?
Spectre, right?
You're the Spectre that just got here, right? You stand out. Probably the guns.
I used to be a military tech. Except for Maeko's people, everyone's too corporate here. They just sit around sipping expensive water.
So what can I do for you today?
I'm the chief mechanic for Hanshan. Just call me Li. Humans have a problem saying my full name.
Got a team of twelve under me, keeping the shuttles coming and going.
You need a pass. You can get one from Anoleis or the managers. If you can polish enough gizzard.
There's the problems up on Peak 15. Synthetic Insights was shut down by Anoleis. And a Matriarch came through.
You looking for her? She took a shuttle to Peak 15 before we lost contact.
Fifteen's always had a lousy reputation. Nobody talks about what they do there. And everyone sent up comes back a little quieter.
Don't know. There's a blizzard up there, but we've had those before. Never cut the satellite uplinks before.
Scuttlebutt says Lorik Qui'in was on the take. So Anoleis shut down SI's offices. Quiet-like, so no offworld lawyers come in on it.
You need anything, I'll be here.
Don't worry. I'm not out to put a slug in your head.
It's a long story. Just thinking about it makes me tired all over.
Sorry, I really can't talk about it.
We managed to catch up with that asari Matriarch.
Would you believe... rachni?
Uh, what?
Yeah, that's me.
How can I get into the garage?
You seem like you have an ear to the ground. What's happening around here?
Do you know where that Matriarch is now?
What sort of problems are there at Peak 15?
What was that about Synthetic Insights?
Who's asking?
